create_levitate_potion_pickup_env: create a MiniHackLCLevitatePotionPickup environment to train an agent to pick up and quaff a levitation potion
create_levitate_ring_pickup_env: create a MiniHackLCLevitateRingPickup environment to train an agent to pick up and wear a levitation ring
create_levitate_mixed_env: create a MiniHackLCLevitate environment that randomly spawns a potion, ring, or boots for levitation
create_lava_cross_full_env: create a MiniHackLC environment using the lava_crossing.des file for full action lava crossing
create_restricted_actions_env: create a MiniHackLCRestrictedActions environment with only compass, pickup, quaff, wear, puton, zap, apply, fire, and read actions
